in_arabic.name: منظَر
in_arabic.meaning: منظَر: المَنظَرُ، مَنظَرٌ، وَمُنتَظَرٌ مُصَلّىً وَمُؤَمِّنًا وَذَا حُجَّةٍ وَصَفيَّةٍ عَلى الَّذِيْنَ اِتَّقَوْا
in_arabic.long_meaning: الْمَنظَرُ: الحَقِيقَةُ، السَخِيُّ، الجَنِيُّ، الَّذِي يُظَنُّ بِالنَصَبِ، وَالْمُنتَظَرُ: المُصَلّى وَمُؤَمِّنَ الَّذِي يُظَنُّ بِالنَصَبِ الَّذِي يُصَلّى عَلى أَنَّهُ أَمَرَ بِالجِهادِ وَإِنَّ الَّذِي اِتَّقَوا بِهِ يَكونُ مُصَلّىً وَمُؤَمِّنًا وَذَا حُجَّةٍ عَلى الَّذِيْنَ اِتَّقَوْا، وَهُوَ بِحَقِيقَةٍ وَسَخِيٍ وَجَنِيٍ، وَهَذِهِ الْأَسْماءُ مِنَ السَمَوَاتِ الأَحسَنَةِ وَالأَعظَمِ مِنَ اللَهِ تَعَالَى

in_urdu.name: منظَر
in_urdu.meaning: منظَر: ایک فاضل، پارسا، نیک، صالح، نیک ذات، نیک کردار
in_urdu.long_meaning: منظَر سے مراد وہ شخص ہے جو اپنے کردار اور اعمال کے لحاظ سے فاضل ہو، اور جو اپنے آپ کو اللہ تعالیٰ اور اس کے رسول صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے احکامات کے لیے مجبور سمجھے، اور جو جہاد میں بھی حصہ لے۔ اس کے لیے یہ نام اس وقت بہت اہم ہے جب کسی نے اللہ تعالیٰ اور اس کے رسول صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی طرف سے جہاد کا فتویٰ دیا ہو۔

in_english.name: Muntazar
in_english.meaning: Muntazar: a pious, righteous, virtuous, and trustworthy person, waiting for Allah's promise
in_english.long_meaning: Muntazar is an Arabic name that means 'a pious, righteous, virtuous, and trustworthy person'. It refers to a person who is waiting for Allah's promise and is characterized by his piety, righteousness, and trustworthiness. According to Islamic tradition, Muntazar is a name that symbolizes patience, perseverance, and trust in Allah's promise. It is a name that is associated with the qualities of a true Muslim, who is committed to following the teachings of Islam and strives to live a righteous life.

The name is derived from the Arabic root 'ntzr', meaning 'to wait' or 'to remain'. In Islamic and Arabic cultures, waiting is an important concept that is often associated with patience, perseverance, and faith. This name is also reminiscent of the names of various Islamic personalities and religious figures who are known by this title, reinforcing the cultural importance of this name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Muntazar is a powerful name that carries deep symbolism and meaning. This name is a reminder of the belief in the One Who is eagerly awaited, whether that be Allah or a prophet. The name is a poignant reminder of the concept of Taqwa or God-consciousness, emphasizing the importance of being patient and remaining steadfast in one's faith and belief in the divine. Furthermore, the name Muntazar is an expression of hope and anticipation, reminding us that even in the midst of suffering or hardship, we can find comfort and strength in the knowledge that the One We Wait For will ultimately come to our aid.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hajar Al-Haytami, in his work 'Al-Fattāh Al-Alamī fī 'Ilm Al-Ta'rīkh', mentions that the title 'Muntazar' was given to the Ottoman Sultan Selim II (1566-1574 AD) due to his anticipation of taking Constantinople (Istanbul) from the Byzantines.

Al-Maqrizi, in his historical work 'Al-Mawāqiş al-Bulqāqīyah fī Aḥkām al-Buldān', mentions that the Fatimid Caliph Al-Mustansir Billah (1094-1101 AD) appointed a man named 'Abd Al-Muttalib Al-Muntasir as the governor of Alexandria.
